title: polypodium lineare subsp. ussuriense
intro: Polypodium lineare subsp. ussuriense, commonly known as Ussuri linear-leaf polypody, is a type of fern that belongs to the Polypodiaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve antioxidant activity. The therapeutic actions of Ussuri linear-leaf polypody include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cardiovascular protective agent. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
